llm_response.reason: The website displays several key scam indicators: it lacks proper links to company information, about, contact, or privacy policy; it uses apparent spoofing of the Silbon clothing brand by presenting itself as the 'Silbon Official Online Store'; there are no appropriate business email addresses or phone numbers provided; privacy and business information is ambiguous; and the site structure consists only of shopping-related internal links. These characteristics are typical of scam online shops trying to mimic legitimate brands in order to steal payments or personal data.
